newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia raises air crash death toll to 18.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia raises air crash death toll to 18.

text.p: Indonesian authorities have raised the death toll from a plane crash in South Kalimantan province over the weekend to 18, the official Antara news agency reported on Monday.

The latest victim died on Sunday evening of severe burns sustained when a twin-engined Casa light aircraft plunged through the roof of a gas factory where he worked about three km (two miles) from the airport in the provincial capital Banjarmasin.
One of the plane's engines had caught fire shortly after take-off on Saturday afternoon. The cause of the fire was still not known.
Antara said 13 of the 15 passengers were killed immediately and a 12-year-old girl died on her way to hospital. The pilot and co-pilot were also killed and one factory worker died on the ground.
The only surviving passenger and two other factory workers were still in hospital in serious condition, Antara said.
The plane had taken off from Banjarmasin's Syamsuddin Noor airport on Saturday for Sampit in Central Kalimantan on Borneo island in overcast weather conditions and drizzle.
